motion.title: Motion library
motion.sub: A short catalogue of motions — jogging, turning, sitting at a café — that the image-to-video engine turns an approved still into. Edit, rename, archive or add your own; nothing here generates anything yet.
motion.newD: A short key, a name in both languages, a motion hint for its category, and whether it is a group clip (cut together from separate clips, never one generated crowd shot).
motion.name: Name (English)
motion.groupClip: Group clip (two or three models together)
motion.confirmArchive: Archive this action? Nothing is deleted — restore it any time.

videos.title: Videos
videos.sub: Turn one of your product's own live photos into a short clip. The clip always moves from an already-approved still — nothing is ever imagined from text.
videos.offNotice: Off today. Turn on "Image-to-video clips" in Settings before requesting a clip.
videos.newD: Pick a product with a live photo, the shape and the length, then price it before you ask for it.
videos.newDOff: Turn the switch on in Settings first.
videos.noProducts: No product has a live photo yet — add one in Products first.
videos.requested: Clip requested — queue it below when you're ready to run it.
videos.costUnset: Cost not set — ask the owner to set a rate in Settings

err.OFF: The video engine is off — turn it on in Settings first.
err.SOURCE_INVALID: This product has no live photo to move from yet.
err.WRONG_STATE: This job has already moved on — the page may need a refresh.
err.CAP_REACHED: This clip has already been tried its limit of times.
err.NOT_FOUND: Not found — the page may need a refresh.

reels.title: Reels
reels.sub: Stitch a handful of your already-approved clips into one reel, with music, text and the logo, cut for every shape you need, then assemble it. No real video compositor is connected yet, so assembling fills in an honest preview output, not a real stitched video.
reels.newD: Pick the approved clips to stitch (in order), the shapes to cut it for, and, if you like, a music track and an overlay.
reels.noApprovedClips: No approved clip yet — review and approve one on the Videos page first.
reels.musicPh: Media id of an audio file
reels.musicHelp: Paste the id of an audio file from your brand asset library — a picker is coming in a later refinement.
reels.built: Reel built — press "Assemble this reel" when you're ready.
reels.assembled: Assembled — a preview output, not a real stitched video yet.
reels.assembleNote: No real video compositor is connected yet. Assembling fills in a preview output (one of your approved clips, shown once per shape) — it does not yet stitch the clips, lay in the music, or bake in the text and logo.

err.NOT_FOUND: Not found — the page may need a refresh.
err.CLIPS_NOT_READY: Every clip must be reviewed and approved on the Videos page first.
err.SOURCE_INVALID: That is not an audio file.
err.WRONG_STATE: This reel has already moved on — the page may need a refresh.

briefs.title: Creative brief
briefs.sub: A few short questions about a campaign, then three ready-made directions to choose from. Nothing is produced until you have seen a direction you like — ask to see the three again as many times as you want.
briefs.offNotice: Off today. Turn on "Creative brief" in Settings before answering one.
briefs.newD: What this campaign is for, who it should reach, the offer and for how long — and, if you like, which products.
briefs.newDOff: Turn the switch on in Settings first.
briefs.noProducts: No product yet — add one in Products first.
briefs.noCampaign: No campaign — answered ahead of one

urgency.name: Urgency — dark background, big timer, strong red
urgency.rationale: {offer}, only {durationDays} day(s) left — built to feel urgent

clean_premium.name: Clean premium — product led, small offer tag
clean_premium.rationale: {purpose}, a clean look with {offer} shown as a small tag

err.OFF: The creative brief is off — turn it on in Settings first.
err.NOT_FOUND: Not found — the page may need a refresh.
err.WRONG_STATE: This brief has already moved on — the page may need a refresh.

hub.title: Studio
hub.sub: Your social accounts, your brand asset library, your post templates and what you've generated from them.
hub.note: Nothing here posts to a real account or spends anything. A generated post is a preview only today (your product's own existing photo) — the real compositor and real posting come in later PRs. A new account always starts off and needing approval.

accounts.namePh: A name for you to recognise it by

models.title: Model library
models.sub: Your own human models for on-model photos: a name, build details, their own reference photos per angle, and their rights/consent record. Nothing here generates an image yet — that starts at a later PR, and it will refuse to run without a valid, unexpired consent record on file.

models.confirmArchive: Archive this model? Nothing is deleted — restore it any time.
models.empty: No model in the library yet.

consent.empty: No consent record on file yet — generation will refuse to run for this model.

renders.d: Pick a template and the products to feature; queue it, then generate it. Today's result is a preview only — your product's own existing photo, not yet a real composite. Real video/image composition and posting come in later PRs.
renders.productsHelp: Paste one or more product ids, separated by commas. A product picker is coming in a later refinement.
renders.caption: Caption (optional)
renders.captionPh: Your own words — nothing here writes this for you yet
renders.noPhoto: None of this job's products has a live photo yet.

posts.d: Turn a finished preview into a post on a Facebook, Instagram or TikTok account, now or held for a chosen time (the calendar below). A new account always needs your approval first, so queuing one here only waits — nothing reaches the real account until that account is set to run free, or you approve it in the queue, and it is then posted (by hand, or by "Run due posts now" once its time comes).
posts.noRenderJobs: Generate something above first (it must finish before it can be posted).
posts.noAccounts: Add and switch on a Facebook, Instagram or TikTok account above first.
posts.captionPh: Leave empty to use the generated content's own caption
posts.captionHelp: Facebook, Instagram and TikTok can be posted to today; YouTube follows in a later PR.
posts.scheduledAtHelp: Leave empty to post the moment this is cleared. Set a time to hold it for the calendar instead.
posts.waitingApproval: This account needs approval before anything from it goes out.

calendar.d: The next two weeks: every post that has a time, or that already went out the moment it was cleared with no time chosen.
calendar.empty: Nothing in the next two weeks yet.

rules.d: A cadence of posts and reels a day, on chosen weekdays, drawing from chosen categories — a preview of the next day it would run on. Picking products and templates and actually sending them still needs a person today; see the guide for why.
rules.categoryIdsHelp: Paste one or more category ids, separated by commas. Leave empty to draw from every category.
rules.noNextActiveDay: No weekday is active, or this rule is off.

export.title: Export
export.sub: Package a product's, a SKU's or a category's already-approved photos and clips into every platform size for a campaign. No real crop engine or ad-account sender is connected yet, so a request only gathers and checks the inputs — producing the sized files is a later refinement.
export.outputNote: No real crop engine is connected yet. Producing fills in a preview output (the selection's own first approved photo, shown once per size) — it does not yet crop it to size, bake in the overlay, or send it anywhere.
export.newD: Pick exactly one of a product, a SKU or a category that already has an approved photo or clip, then the platform sizes to cut it for.
export.withOverlay: Pull the price/offer overlay from the campaign
export.campaignIdPh: Id of a campaign on the Marketing calendar
export.requested: Export requested — producing the sized files is a later refinement.
export.produced: Produced — a preview output, not real sized files yet.

overlay.title: Campaign overlays
overlay.sub: A small label drawn on top of the product card, the listing and the product page while a campaign is running — a corner ribbon, a bottom strip, a badge or a struck-price flag. It is never saved onto the photo and it never changes the price; it appears when you turn it on and disappears the moment you turn it off or its window ends.
overlay.newD: Pick a look, write the words in both languages and a colour, choose what it reaches (every product, named products, or a category), and an optional start and end. It starts switched off — turn it on once you have checked it.
overlay.slugsHelp: Comma-separated, by their own address slug (e.g. polo-navy, polo-white or polos, formal-shirts).
overlay.added: Overlay added — it is off until you turn it on.
overlay.confirmArchive: Archive this overlay? Nothing is deleted — restore it any time.
